review_comment: The patch adds is_safe_url validation to prevent open redirects in the language setting view. User-controlled 'next' parameter from request.REQUEST or HTTP_REFERER header is now validated to ensure redirect targets are same-origin before being used in HttpResponseRedirect. This prevents attackers from crafting malicious links that redirect users to external phishing sites. Ensure is_safe_url properly validates all URL schemes and handles edge cases like encoded redirects.

The patch adds essential validation for user-controlled redirect URLs in comment flows. The is_safe_url() check prevents open redirects by ensuring redirect URLs are safe (same host) before use. When validation fails, the code falls back to a safe URL, maintaining functionality while preventing exploitation. Ensure is_safe_url() properly validates against request.get_host() and consider edge cases like subdomain validation.

Added security validation prevents open redirect attacks by ensuring redirect URLs are safe for the current host. The is_safe_url check validates that user-controlled redirect_to parameters do not point to external domains before processing authentication redirects. This addresses CWE-601 by implementing proper host validation for redirect URLs in the authentication flow.

This addition implements core open redirect prevention by validating that redirect URLs either have no netloc (relative URLs) or match the current host. The control properly addresses the primary mechanism of CWE-601 by comparing parsed URL components against trusted host values. Ensure comprehensive testing covers edge cases including internationalized domain names and URL encoding variations.
line_snippet: return not netloc or netloc == host

review_comment: The patch adds essential host validation for user-controlled redirect URLs in the logout view. The is_safe_url function validates that the next_page parameter only redirects to the current host, preventing open redirect attacks. This security control ensures that logout redirects cannot be exploited to redirect users to malicious external sites. Ensure is_safe_url implements comprehensive validation including protocol restrictions and proper host matching.
